This summary covers the period from 2026-05-29 to 2026-06-04, encompassing the last seven days of ROBI’s operation. During this time, ROBI processed a total of 100 orders, with 17 successfully delivered, 17 delivered with warnings, and 66 orders marked as failed. The average fetch time was 54 seconds, with 47 seconds dedicated to the robot’s work, and a median fetch time of 64 seconds. 

Notably, ROBI experienced a high volume of failures this week, specifically with [[reachability]]_failed (34 instances), [[no-valid-depth]] (17 instances), and [[handover]]_failed (16 instances), alongside 16 [[search-exhausted]] events. A total of 68 retries were recorded across all orders, with 34 orders requiring a [[retry]]. Furthermore, ROBI issued 340 collision warnings during this period.
